symptoms.name: Fatigue
symptoms.description: Feeling unusually tired is common during treatment. It may not improve with rest, but gentle activity, good nutrition, and enough sleep can help. Talk to your care team if it feels severe or persistent.

symptoms.name: Nausea
symptoms.description: Feeling sick to your stomach can be managed with medication, eating small frequent meals, and avoiding strong smells.

symptoms.name: Pain
symptoms.description: Pain should be reported to your care team. There are many ways to manage it effectively.

symptoms.name: Headache
symptoms.description: Headaches can have many causes. Stay hydrated and track their frequency and intensity.

symptoms.name: Dizziness
symptoms.description: Dizziness should be reported to your care team, especially if it affects your balance or daily activities.

symptoms.name: Fever
symptoms.description: Fever can be a sign of infection. Contact your care team if your temperature is above 100.4°F (38°C).

symptoms.name: Cough
symptoms.description: A persistent cough should be monitored and reported to your care team.
